- Top Row: Q -> W -> E -> R -> T -> Y -> U -> I -> O -> P -> Q
- Middle Row: A -> S -> D -> F -> G -> H -> J -> K -> L -> A
- Bottom Row: Z -> X -> C -> V -> B -> N -> M -> Z
